title: Stories on Stage Youth Company
auditions_form_blurb: Registration includes a calendar conflicts form so we can cast around your family's schedule. Please complete this before the audition date.
explainer_body:
Stories on Stage is PYT's annual program adapting beloved children's literature into short, accessible stage performances. Each production runs about 45 minutes — long enough to tell a real story, short enough for our youngest audience members to stay engaged.

The annual youth company casts about 20–30 young performers (ages 12–18) through a single audition each September. Due to small cast sizes and rehearsal schedule, Stories on Stage is a limited-cast program. We cannot guarantee that all who audition will be cast. Most actors are cast in 1–3 productions across the year, depending on casting and calendar conflict dates performers provide up front. This gives young actors a real season's worth of experience, while keeping weekly rehearsal commitment manageable. Rehearsals generally run on Tuesday and Sunday evenings, for 4-5 weeks. 

Stories on Stage performs at Mountain View Center for the Performing Arts' Second Stage. Performances for school audiences take place on one Friday morning per production, and for the public on one Saturday per production.
